title: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwich
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Kali mirch (Black pepper) crushed ¼ tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Kali mirch (Black pepper) crushed ¼ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add butter,black pepper crushed,garlic powder,salt & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein makhan,kali mirch crushed,lehsan powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Cut rolls/ buns from the center & apply garlic butter.
steps.romanUrdu: -Rolls/buns ko center mein sa cut ker lein & garlic butter laga lein.

steps.instruction: -Heat cast iron pan,toast rolls/buns & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Cast iron pan ko garam karein aur rolls/buns ko toast ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -In a cast iron pan,add cooking oil,onion & sauté until translucent.
steps.romanUrdu: -Cast iron pan mein cooking oil aur pyaz dal dein aur translucent hunay tak sauté ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add capsicum,black pepper crushed,salt,mix well & stir fry for a minute & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Shimla mirch,kali mirch crushed aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur ek minute kliya stir fry ker lein & side per rakh dein.
-Beef steak ko thin slices mein cut ker lein.

steps.instruction: -In the same cast iron pan,add cooking oil,beef slices & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Us he cast iron pan mein cooking oil aur beef slices dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add black pepper crushed,salt,mix well & cook on medium flame until tender (6-8 minutes) then cook on high flame until it dries up.
steps.romanUrdu: -Kali mirch crushed aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur darmiyani ancch per gul janay tak paka lein (6-8 minutes) phir tez ancch per sukh janay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: -Add stir fried vegetables,worcestershire sauce & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Stir fried vegetables aur worcestershire sauce dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.
-Mozzarella cheese dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Cut cheddar cheese slice into triangles & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Cheddar cheese slice ko triangles mein cut ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -On toasted rolls/buns,add prepared cheesesteak filling,cheddar cheese slices & cover with top bun to make a sandwich & serve (makes 4).
steps.romanUrdu: -Toasted rolls/buns per tayyar cheesesteak filling & cheddar cheese slices dal dein aur top bun sa cover ker ka sandwich tayyar ker lein (makes 4).

ogDescription: This Cheesesteak recipe is easier than you think. Tender steak, Olper’s Cheese, caramelized onions hugged by toasted bread, a classical way to make Philly
